# Frontend quickstart

## Prerequisites

You'll need:

- **Node.js and npm** installed ([install guide](https://nodejs.org))
- **A language model backend** running
  - [Llama.cpp](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp)
  - Or any OpenAI-compatible API

## Install

Install the Agent Smith terminal client globally:

```bash
npm i -g @agent-smith/cli
```

Then run `lm init` from the directory where you want your environment. It installs the default plugins (filesystem, shell, agents and search), creates the config file, and offers to clone and build the graphical user interface:

```bash
mkdir agent-smith-env && cd agent-smith-env
lm init
# answer "yes" when asked to install the GUI
```

Accepting the GUI prompt clones `agent-smith-ui` into the current directory, installs its dependencies (`npm i`) and builds it (`npm run build`).

### Manual install

Prefer to do it manually? Clone and build the UI yourself (plugins can still be installed with `lm plugin <name>` or `lm init`):

```bash
cd agent-smith-env
git clone https://github.com/lynxai-team/agent-smith-ui.git
cd agent-smith-ui
# install dependencies
npm i
# build
npm run build
```

## Run

Start the UI from the cloned folder:

```bash
cd agent-smith-ui
npm run local
```

This will run an install wizard on first launch: follow the process to install plugins and create a workspace.

A Llama.cpp local backend is configured by default. To add or remove backends edit `~/.config/agent-smith/config.yml`.
